nodes.label: Incremental Update (--update)
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts new/changed files against the saved manifest; code-only changes skip semantic extraction entirely (no LLM), and changed video files must be transcribed first or raw media paths reach subagents unreadable.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files because changed files are handled by replace-on-re-extract - pruning changed files would delete the freshly re-extracted content (#1178/#1344); root= relativization keeps prune paths matching graph paths (#1361).

nodes.label: Cluster-Only Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Self-contained CLI command that re-clusters, relabels, and regenerates outputs from the existing graph; Steps 5-9 must NOT be re-run because they read intermediate files a prior build's cleanup already deleted (#1392).
